title: Maximum conventional Read Holding Registers quantity
purpose: Exercise a large but conventionally valid register quantity so request parsing, response byte-count calculation, and buffer sizing are stressed without breaking the visible request length fields.

messages.label: Read Holding Registers request, unit 01, address 0, quantity 125

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the request as a valid Read Holding Registers operation and produce either a response containing 125 registers or a normal exception if the mapped range is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the five-byte FC03 request PDU plus unit identifier.
Quantity 007d is 125, a conventional valid maximum for a single register-read request.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: This candidate explores a valid length boundary related to issue reports involving test-server parsing and reply handling. It does not use the documented malformed input or any historical crash sequence.
